description: Stop a notebook’s in-flight answer — the UI’s “Stop” on a streaming reply. RPC-backed. Fire-and-forget: the server does not confirm, so `cancelled: true` means the stop was sent, not that a turn was running. Defaults to the most recent conversation.

conversation_id.description: A specific conversation. Defaults to the most recent one.

name: cancel_answer

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
